name: @tol/crypto
description: Lockbox crypto core (earlier, P9): real AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption via Node's built-in crypto, envelope encryption with a per-lockbox DEK, Shamir (2-of-3) threshold secret sharing over the DEK (SEALER/OPERATOR/ESCROW roles — see ADR-0001/ADR-0009), and signed receipts (HMAC-SHA256). Zero runtime dependencies — Node's own crypto module supplies every primitive. Pure, zero-DB; apps/api's lockbox module is the only consumer. See docs/adr/0009-lockbox-crypto.md.
